title: Mystery Surrounds Damage to Russian Baltic Sea Cable
description: A Russian Baltic Sea telecoms cable was damaged, allegedly by external impact, according to Rostelecom. Restoration work is ongoing with no subscriber impact. The incident is part of a trend of outages in the region, ambiguously linked to ongoing geopolitical tensions, exacerbated by Russia's Ukraine invasion.

title: Zelenskyy confirms a new Ukrainian offensive in Russia's Kursk region

title: What Trump's freeze on US foreign aid means for Ukraine
description: The Trump administration's decision at the end of January to freeze billions of dollars in US foreign aid was a shock to humanitarian agencies worldwide, including Ukraine, where USAID and State Department funding has played a vital role since the start of Russia's invasion three years ago.

title: 'Let's do a deal': Zelenskyy touts Ukraine's rare earth stores to Trump
description: Donald Trump has said he wants Ukraine to supply the US with critical resources in exchange for financial support in its war with Russia.

title: Trump wants a deal for Ukraine's natural resources as 'payback' in exchange for aid stopping Russia attack: envoy
description: Ukraine is home to roughly 5% of the world's mineral resources, with rich deposits of titanium, uranium, iron, manganese and lithium -- as well as oil and gas.
